Identified three network segments with accessible live hosts, providing a baseline for future lateral movement plans
fails: No exploit or privilege escalation achieved despite multiple mentor calls, leading to 0% success rate

key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase completed but campaign halted before any exploitation; focus should shift to credential access and exploitation attempts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple hosts respond to ping sweep
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted nmap -sC -sV scan on each host

skill_cards.if_condition: When ssh login attempts fail with default creds
skill_cards.then_action: Capture ssh banners and save for offline credential profiling
